job.name: ig21_host
job.meaning: директор ~48, тёмно-синий костюм, белая рубашка без галстука, стеклянный офис
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a serious but kind Russian company director about 48 with short dark hair greying at the temples, clean-shaven, a well-fitted dark navy suit and a white shirt without a tie, standing calmly with hands loosely together at waist level, a businesslike expression. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium shot from the waist up, both shoulders and hands inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, NO broad smile. Look: a real frame from a high-end camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark. Background: a modern glass-walled office with a meeting room and city view, cool daylight, blurred.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
